newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia shipping line posts A$6.3 mln loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia shipping line posts A$6.3 mln loss.

text.p: Australian government-owned shipping line ANL Ltd said on Thursday it recorded a loss after tax and abnormals of A$6.3 million for the year to June 30.
The result compared with a loss of A$30.9 million in the previous year, chairman Ted Anson said in a statement.

Anson said ANL was committed to achieving profitability and in that regard any loss was disappointing. However, he said it was encouraging that this was the second year in which the company's performance had improved.
The Australian government plans to sell ANL.
